text.description: A string, or one per language: { "zh": "…", "en": "…" }

name.description: Your name or studio name / 你的名字

tagline.description: Shown next to the name, e.g. Video Works / 影像作品

description.description: Used for search engines and share cards / 搜索与分享卡片的简介

contact.description: Email or a URL / 邮箱或链接

url.description: Public site URL, for share-card images. On GitHub Pages it is filled in automatically / 站点地址

shareImage.description: Image for X / WeChat share cards (relative to public/). 1200×630 works best

title.description: Optional for YouTube / Bilibili / Vimeo / TikTok / Xinpianchang — fetched automatically

src.description: mp4 path under public/ (e.g. media/film.mp4), an mp4 URL, or a YouTube / Bilibili / Vimeo / TikTok / Xinpianchang / Douyin link. Use { "zh": …, "en": … } to serve different sources per language.

cover.description: Optional. Path under public/ or an image URL. Without it: a frame from the mp4, or the platform's own cover

aspect.description: Optional, e.g. "9:16" or "3:4". Detected automatically for mp4

embed.description: Set true if src is any other embeddable player URL
